about: The performance pass (tools/perf/README.md): each of its fixes switched off by one small change to its source (vite.config.ts HS_SWITCH, test build only); each must make a guard of acceptance/perf.json fail (tools/behaviour/switches.mjs --package '^perf$'). A switch here brings a cause back without changing what the page shows, so only the guards can catch it.

switches.feature: perf: a model is asked again only when what it read changed
switches.find: if (!touched(l.reads, l.s, s)) { l.s = s; return l.v; }
switches.replace: if (!touched(l.reads, l.s, s) && false) { l.s = s; return l.v; }

switches.feature: perf: a tile's measurement is kept
perf: a preview is measured as the tile it copies
perf: the layout's own moves are not a change of content
perf: a layout is solved once for the same tiles
switches.find: l = solved.get(k); if (l) return remember(k, l);
switches.replace: l = solved.get(k); if (l && false) return remember(k, l);

switches.feature: perf: an Undo is one update of the store
switches.find: const r = e.run ? { moved: true, note: e.run.undo() ?? null, next: null } : cross(e.after, e.before), now = get();
switches.replace:
set({ gone: { ...get().gone } });
      const r = e.run ? { moved: true, note: e.run.undo() ?? null, next: null } : cross(e.after, e.before), now = get();

switches.feature: perf: a gesture is not state
perf: the focus request is a leaf of its own
switches.find: const say = useSay(), panels = usePanels(), drawer = usePanelStore(s => s.drawer);
switches.replace: const say = useSay(), panels = usePanels(), drawer = usePanelStore(s => s.drawer); useDesk(s => s.focus);
